user_story: As a user, I want to select a car from a dropdown menu so that I can choose my preferred vehicle from the list of options provided. Acceptance Criteria: When I visit the 'Select Menu' page at 'https://demoqa.com/select-menu', I should see a dropdown menu with the id 'cars'. When I select 'Volvo' from the dropdown, it should be selected successfully. If I do not select any option and try to submit, I should remain on the same page without any navigation away from 'https://demoqa.com/select-menu'.
